author: Ruhi Cenet Documentaries
description:
I ate mad honey. At first, my body temperature started changing. Then, my fingers went numb. The room began to spin. And soon, everything got out of control.
Mad honey is different than normal honey, it contains grayanotoxins, which can cause hallucinations or temporary paralysis. I ate it just for myself, don't try this.
Nepal's Mad Honey That Causes Hallucinations (They climb to go insane): https://youtu.be/PUYMvYcz3ZI
title: I ate hallucinogenic Mad Honey (It destroyed me)
